data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest editorial image for an organic product post
Input images: Image 1 is the exact product reference and the product identity must remain visually faithful.
Primary request: Photograph the exact small blue Butt Station desk organizer as the lone Blue Period object in a quiet contemporary design gallery, treated with dead-serious curatorial restraint rather than as an advertisement.
Scene/backdrop: pale limestone gallery wall and low honed-stone plinth, with one soft out-of-focus archway in the distance; no signage.
Subject: the exact small organizer from Image 1 at ordinary 6-to-8-inch desk-object scale: smooth bright-blue seated human-like figure on a white toilet-bowl base; clear tape roll carried by one bent arm; extended blue leg with the metal tape cutter at the foot; lime-yellow rectangular pen block behind it holding one blue pen; a few colored paperclips in the small bowl. All parts must form one coherent physical molded-plastic product.
Style/medium: believable editorial design-magazine photography with quiet absurdity, tactile real materials, sophisticated and sparse, not ecommerce or campaign art.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3; entire little product fully visible in the lower-middle third on a broad plinth; generous asymmetrical gallery space; eye-level three-quarter view; no border, no type, no layout modules.
Lighting/mood: soft north-window daylight, subtle limestone bounce, gentle physical contact shadow, museum calm.
Color palette: chalk limestone and warm gray with only the product's exact bright blue, white, lime-yellow, clear tape, and small paperclip accents.
Materials/textures: smooth molded blue plastic, matte white plastic, translucent clear tape, brushed metal cutter, honed limestone.
Text: No text anywhere.
Constraints: preserve the strange seated anatomy and every functional part from Image 1; one blue figure only; one tape roll only; ordinary desk-organizer scale; do not transform it into a real person, ceramic sculpture, toilet, or generic art figure; no duplicated limbs; no missing tape cutter; no extra objects; no packaging; no brand marks; no CTA; no badges; no product-card frame; no watermark; no ad template.
Avoid: large monumental scale, labels or wall text, hands, people, ropes or barriers, price tags, glossy product ad lighting, visual clutter, malformed anatomy, duplicated accessories.
